title: 规则

series.next: Midnight on the fifteenth. Someone outside 804 is saying a name.

setting: Flat 804, 11 pm, the night after the stairs. Tomorrow is the fifteenth of the seventh month.

wuye.name: 物业
wuye.en: the property office's night man, with a torch

steps.narr: 804. You and 物业 search the flat by torchlight.

steps.zh: 中元那天晚上，她叫得最响。
steps.en: On that night, she calls the loudest.

else.narr: Your phone buzzes. 小郑: still hiding...

say.en: Ask him what happened to the people who lived here before.
answers: 以前住这里的人去哪了？
say.gloss: What about the people who lived here before?
say.tip: ……呢？ asks where something has got to: 以前住这儿的人呢？ = and the people who lived here before?

ok.zh: 都住不久。都说有人叫他们。
ok.en: None of them stayed long. They all said someone called them.

fail.zh: 中元那天晚上，她叫得最响。
fail.en: On that night, she calls the loudest.

answers: 以前的房客后来都去哪了？
以前的房客，后来都去哪儿了？
3.gloss: Where did the tenants before me all end up?
3.tip: 后来 hòulái = afterwards, later on: 后来都去哪了？ = where did they all go, in the end?

steps.en: Where are your notes? Read me one.

say.en: Read him one of the rules aloud. Careful which.

not.note: You just said 四! Read one of the other two: 别回答, or 别跑.

say.tip: 第 dì makes a number an ordinal: 第一条 = rule one. 条 tiáo counts rules, lines, fish.

answers: 第一条说：有人叫你，别回答。
第一条：有人叫你，千万别回答。
3.gloss: Rule one says: if someone calls you, don't answer.

steps.narr: Behind the wardrobe: a folded list. Not your handwriting.

steps.zh: 这是阿梅的字。十年前住这儿。
steps.en: That's 阿梅's writing. She lived here ten years ago.

steps.narr: The same three rules. Rule one is crossed out.
Beside it, in a shaky hand: answer me.

steps.zh: 每个人的纸条，都是自己的字。
steps.en: Everyone's notes were in their own handwriting.
Which rule is the false one?

say.en: Tell him which rule is false.
say.gloss: Rule one is the false one.

not.note: That rule held. Which one did 阿梅 cross out?

say.tip: 假的 jiǎ de = false, fake. 真的 zhēn de = true.

miss.narr: You say it before you think: rule two, don't say 四.

miss.en: The lift... it's stopped at four again.

answers: 第一条是假的，她想要人回答。
第一条是假的，她在等人回答。
3.gloss: Rule one is false. She wants someone to answer.

steps.zh: 明天晚上，你打算怎么办？
steps.en: So what will you do tomorrow night?

say.en: Wait for her alone, or ask him to wait with you.
say.tip: 自己 zìjǐ = myself, on my own. 等 děng = wait for.

ok.en: All right. I'll be just downstairs.

alts.en: Or: ask him to wait with you

then.en: All right. I'll stay with you.

fail.zh: 明天晚上，你打算怎么办？
fail.en: So what will you do tomorrow night?

answers: 我自己等她，看她想说什么。
我一个人等她，听她想说什么。
3.gloss: I'll wait for her myself, and hear what she wants to say.

answers: 你陪我等吧，我有点害怕。
你陪我一起等吧，我有点怕。
alts.gloss: Wait with me. I'm a bit scared.

steps.en: 物业 leaves you his torch. Tomorrow is the fifteenth. 🔦
